messages.text: Sourcing: Stockline raised its price to 0.04 (was 0.02). Our sell price is 0.04, so margin is 0 and the 0.03 cap refuses every buy. Ridgeline is 0.05 (a loss). I have paused buying and am serving from cache only. To keep buying Stockline at a margin of at least 0.01, I need either a sell price of at least 0.05 or a mandate cap of at least 0.04 with the sell price raised to 0.05. Peakview (0.01, x402) is not on my approved supplier list, so I have not paid it. Please advise.

Treasury: I sent the CFO a rebalance with two options. P-0001 (my recommendation): sell price 0.05, your cap 0.04, your budget 10.00 to 14.00, so 0.01 margin on each Stockline buy. P-0002: sell price 0.06 for 0.02 margin. Keep serving from cache until the CFO approves one. Don't buy Ridgeline (0.05, a loss) and don't pay Peakview: it's not on your approved supplier list, and that doesn't change.
